src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes: utilise stalling and releasing around 5.4M boss HP to avoid nulled damage.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4"><ins><nowiki>Phase 4</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This phase varies by base and team, on master+ teams it's best to immediately kill 4 scarabs and throw 2 in each portal then utilise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1" alt="prismofsalvation" title="prismofsalvation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153798975498.png?v=1" alt="surgemobile" title="surgemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378665802235968.png?v=1" alt="divemobile" title="divemobile" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478668630265958471.png?v=1" alt="gchaincaroming" title="gchaincaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to handle dogs and click both portals</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Amascut</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Start with at least 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1" alt="bloodlust" title="bloodlust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → s</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1" alt="adaptivestrike" title="adaptivestrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1" alt="bloodlust" title="bloodlust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1" alt="ezk" title="ezk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-5"><ins><nowiki>Phase 5</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Around the time both solo charges are done and both middle fragments are at 50%, prepare with: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1" alt="adaptivestrike" title="adaptivestrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>As Tumeken's reform starts, move next to Tumeken and wait till 'GET OUT OF MY WAY' → (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1" alt="ezk" title="ezk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080527.png?v=1" alt="gfury" title="gfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improvise</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>It's important for G1/G2 not to move in front of the boss, until the last interceptor has moved back into charging position, this allows for continuous charging for the fastest phase time and skipping 1 jump.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>All other charging roles need to swap positions with max 1t delay as well for the perfect charge.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Click middle when charge is 1t off, filled or 1t after filled on the same tick that the green lines appear on the floor.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Perfect Charge Animation:</nowiki></em><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/SwoHU0Kevv.mp4 <nowiki>150 Charging Method</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
